description: The file defines a Cache class that provides an interface for cache storage, supporting get, set, and delete operations. It dynamically loads a specific cache adaptor class based on the constructor parameter.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A class providing caching functionality with support for different cache adaptors loaded dynamically based on the provided type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cache object with a specified adaptor type and optional expiry time, dynamically loading the adaptor class.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a given key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data in cache under a specific key with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes cached data associated with a specific key.
